Redcliffe Hotel Inverness | Relax in luxury
Relax in luxury
Blending Georgian elegance with modern comfort, The Redcliffe Hotel and townhouse has 23 boutique rooms and fantastic dining choices in the heart of Inverness just minutes away from inverness castle and the city centre. Expect fantastic service and a friendly welcome at this independent, family-run hotel. Whether exploring the rugged highlands or watching the sunset with a cocktail from our beautiful secluded terrace, The Redliffe will create memories for a lifetime.
Book a Room Direct Pay Less

Lovely room looking out on the castle. Food piping hot and very good (breakfast and dinner), friendly staff and great service, very central too-recommended.
Alice Harper
Fantastic stay here staff all very friendly and welcoming.. room very comfortable and food was great too.. would definately recommend staying here.
Maura Martin
Waiting staff attentive and welcoming.Food verywell presented and great value.Takes the humble fish and chips to a new level .Visited on two consecutive nights thoroughly enjoyed the experience.
Niki T
Stayed here for a week and would definitely return here to stay! Friendly employees, the lady that cleans does such an amazing job! The breakfast that is provided is so yummy and the dinner is amazing as well! Super cozy place and very close to everything!
